name: oldstat
description: The oldstat system call retrieves information about a file specified by pathname and stores it in the buffer pointed to by statbuf. It is an older version of the stat system call with a narrower structure format for compatibility in early systems.

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Pathname of the file to retrieve information about

parameters.name: statbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer where file status information is stored

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Search permission is denied for one of the directories in the path prefix of pathname
Too many symbolic links encountered while traversing the path
A component of pathname does not exist or is a dangling symbolic link
A component of the path prefix of pathname is not a directory
File size, inode number, or number of blocks cannot be represented in the appropriate types

bugs: Fields in the stat structure may contain state information from different moments during execution, and use of st_blocks and st_blksize may be less portable across systems.
